CINCINNATI STATE IS AN ELIGIBLE APPLICANT UNDER SECTION C1. AS AN ACCREDITED INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION.THE PROJECT IS ELIGIBLE UNDER THE FOLLOWING CATEGORIES IN SECTION C1, INCLUDING PROJECTS THAT:A. ESTABLISH NEW EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS THAT TEACH TECHNICAL SKILLS USED IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE  B. ESTABLISH SCHOLARSHIPS IN THE AVIATION MAINTENANCE INDUSTRY  C. SUPPORT OUTREACH ABOUT CAREERS IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE  AND E. SUPPORT TRANSITION TO CAREERS IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE, INCLUDING FOR MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES.WORK SUMMARY: THROUGH THIS PROJECT, CINCINNATI STATE WILL ESTABLISH A HIGH SCHOOL AMT PROGRAM IN THE NORTHERN KENTUCKY PORTION OF GREATER CINCINNATI, AN AREA OF MORE THEN 400,000 RESIDENTS, 15 HIGH SCHOOLS AND TWO CAREER CENTERS IN BOTH URBAN AND RURAL SETTINGS THAT CURRENTLY DOES NOT HAVE CONVENIENT ACCESS TO TO AN AMT PROGRAM WITHOUT CROSSING THE OHIO RIVER INTO INTO HARRISON, OHIO 30-PLUS MILES AWAY, OR TRAVELING TO LOUISVILLE 90 MILES TO THE SOUTH. STUDENTS COMPLETING THE PROGRAM WILL BE ABLE TO TEST FOR AN FAA AIRFRAME CERTIFICATE BEFORE OR UPON GRADUATING FROM HIGH SCHOOL. THE PROGRAM WILL ESTABLISH A LOCATION NEAR CVG INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT AND WORK CLOSELY WITH AMT EMPLOYERS THROUGHOUT THE REGION, WHICH IS SEEING SOARING DEMAND FOR AVIATION MECHANICS. THE PROJECT WILL ALSO OFFER AMT EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES FOR ADULT STUDENTS AND VETERANS, SCHOLARSHIPS, AND CONDUCT SIGNIFICANT OUTREACH THROUGHOUT NORTHERN KENTUCKY. OBJECTIVES INCLUDE:  OPEN A NEW SITE IN NORTHERN KENTUCKY THAT WILL ALLOW FOR DELIVERY OF THE AIRFRAME CERTIFICATE TO HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS AND ADULT LEARNERS ESTABLISH PARTNERSHIPS WITH LOCAL NORTHERN KENTUCKY HIGH SCHOOLS AND CAREER CENTERS TO PROVIDE FAA APPROVED AMT PROGRAMMING THAT LEADS TO COLLEGE CREDIT AND CERTIFICATIONS  CONDUCT AMT OUTREACH EFFORTS FOR STUDENTS, UNDERREPRESENTED COMMUNITIES, ADULTS, AND VETERANS THROUGHOUT NORTHERN KENTUCKY

THE EXISTING AVIATION PROGRAM SERVES A LARGE PERCENTAGE OF THE STATE OF IOWA AND SURROUNDING STATES. THE PROPOSED PROJECT AIMS TO DEVELOP A HIGH SCHOOL AVIATION PROGRAM, EXPAND THE GROWING DRONE PROGRAM, AND DEVELOP A ROTARY WING PROGRAM.THE IOWA LAKES MISSION IS, TO PROVIDE OPPORTUNITIES FOR QUALITY LIFELONG LEARNING AND PROMOTE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT FOR OUR COMMUNITIES. THE AVIATION PROGRAM HAS REPRESENTATIVES WORKING TOGETHER TO ENSURE NORTHWEST IOWA HAS A SKILLED WORKFORCE, SEEKING OUT NEW STANDARDS-BASED ACTIVITIES, CURRICULUM, MATERIALS, AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN ROBOTICS, CODING, AND DRONES, AND IDENTIFYING INDUSTRY PARTNERSHIPS FOR STUDENTS IN STEM FIELDS.IOWA LAKES IS DEVELOPING PROGRAMS THAT SPECIFICALLY RELATE TO THE GROWTH OF THE AVIATION WORKFORCE. THE EXISTING AVIATION AND AIRPORT MANAGEMENT PROGRAM HAS GROWN SUBSTANTIALLY IN RECENT YEARS, INCLUDING BECOMING ONE OF ONLY 23 COLLEGES IN THE COUNTRY TO HOST JUNIOR RESERVE OFFICERS TRAINING CORPS (JROTC) TRAINING UNDER CONTRACT WITH THE U.S. AIR FORCE. HAVING A SOLID FOUNDATION, THE COLLEGE HOPES TO EXPAND OUR CAPABILITY TO FORM A PIPELINE FROM AREA HIGH SCHOOLS. THE INAUGURAL COHORT, AS DESCRIBED IN THE NARRATIVE, WOULD SERVE 50 STUDENTS FROM HIGH SCHOOLS IN ALL FIVE COUNTIES OF THE IOWA LAKES REGION.

PROJECT ABSTRACT SUMMARYAERSALE, INC. APPLIES FOR THIS GRANT OPPORTUNITY AS THE HOLDER OF A CERTIFICATE UNDER 14 C.F.R. PART 145.  THE AERSALE ACE ACADEMY PROJECT IS AN ELIGIBLE PROJECT AS OUTLINED IN THE NOFO, SECTION C.1 IN THE CATEGORY OF PROJECTS THAT ESTABLISH SCHOLARSHIPS OR APPRENTICESHIPS FOR INDIVIDUALS PURSUING EMPLOYMENT IN THE AVIATION MAINTENANCE INDUSTRY AND PROJECTS THAT SUPPORT OUTREACH ABOUT CAREERS IN THE AVIATION MAINTENANCE INDUSTRY TO: PRIMARY, SECONDARY AND POST-SECONDARY SCHOOL STUDENTS  OR COMMUNITIES UNDERREPRESENTED IN THE INDUSTRY AND PROJECTS THAT SUPPORT EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES RELATED TO AVIATION MAINTENANCE IN ECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED GEOGRAPHICAL AREAS AND  PROJECTS THAT SUPPORT TRANSITION TO CAREERS IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE, INCLUDING FOR MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES.ESTABLISHED IN 2008, AERSALE IS A PUBLICLY TRADED COMPANY PROVIDING MAINTENANCE, REPAIR, AND OVERHAUL (MRO) SERVICES, PART SALES, AND AIRCRAFT AND ENGINE LEASING, SERVING OVER 1,000 GLOBAL CLIENTS. THE COMPANY OPERATES SIX PART 145 CERTIFIED REPAIR FACILITIES IN THE U.S.THIS PROPOSAL ADDRESSES CHALLENGES IN THE AVIATION INDUSTRY, INCLUDING A SHORTAGE OF TRAINED WORKERS AND ATTRACTING NEW TALENT TO AVIATION MAINTENANCE. THE SECTOR IS PROJECTED TO SEE A DEMAND FOR 125,000 NEW AVIATION MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN (AMT) JOBS IN NORTH AMERICA BY 2042. AERSALE AIMS TO NURTURE INTEREST IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE EARLY, GIVEN INCREASING AIR TRAVEL AND MAINTENANCE NEEDS.THE AERSALE ACE ACADEMY IS PROPOSED AS A SOLUTION. THIS PROGRAM AIMS TO CREATE APPRENTICESHIP AND SCHOLARSHIP OPPORTUNITIES FOR UNDERREPRESENTED CITIZENS, FOCUSING ON ECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED NEIGHBORHOODS, TRANSITIONING SERVICEMEMBERS, AND HISTORICALLY MARGINALIZED GROUPS. THE ACADEMY OFFERS PATHWAYS TO BECOME CERTIFIED AVIATION MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS.THE PROJECT PLAN OUTLINES MULTIPLE PATHWAYS FOR AMT CAREERS:1.ACE APPRENTICESHIP: A 90-DAY INTENSIVE PROGRAM FOR TECHNICAL TRAINING ALIGNED WITH FAA STANDARDS AND COMPANY POLICIES.2.SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM: HIGH-PERFORMING INDIVIDUALS RECEIVE A $2,500 SCHOLARSHIP FOR A LOCAL PART 147 AVIATION MAINTENANCE TECHNICAL SCHOOL (AMTS).3.A P TRACK: CANDIDATES NOT SELECTED FOR SCHOLARSHIPS CAN GAIN EXPERIENCE WITH AERSALE AND PURSUE A P CERTIFICATIONS THROUGH EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS.4.OTHER OPPORTUNITIES: PARTICIPANTS NOT PURSUING AMT CAREERS WILL BE CONSIDERED FOR OTHER MAINTENANCE-RELATED POSITIONS WITHIN THE COMPANY.THE WORK PLAN INCLUDES RECRUITMENT EFFORTS, PARTNERSHIPS WITH LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS, DEVELOPING MARKETING MATERIALS, APPRENTICESHIP HIRING AND TRAINING, AND PROGRAM SUSTAINABILITY.AERSALE S RESOURCES AND CAPABILITIES ENCOMPASS SIX STATE-OF-THE-ART PART 145-CERTIFIED REPAIR STATIONS, A ROBUST TRAINING PROGRAM, AND ESTABLISHED PARTNERSHIPS WITH LOCAL AMTSS AND REGULATORY AUTHORITIES.MR. JORDAN CREEL, DIRECTOR OF QUALITY, WILL OVERSEE PROJECT EXECUTION. INTERNAL CONTROLS WILL SEGREGATE GRANT TRANSACTIONS, AND AERSALE MAINTAINS DOCUMENTED POLICIES AND EXPERIENCE MANAGING LARGE REGULATORY PROJECTS.THE AERSALE ACE ACADEMY AIMS TO IMPACT 50 PARTICIPANTS INITIALLY, WITH THE POTENTIAL TO SERVE 100 IF A SECOND YEAR OF FUNDING BECOMES AVAILABLE. THE PROGRAM TARGETS VETERANS, ECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED INDIVIDUALS, AND UNDERREPRESENTED POPULATIONS, OFFERING THEM PATHS TO WELL-PAYING AMT CAREERS, SUPPORTING FAMILIES AND COMMUNITIES.TO ASSESS SUCCESS, AERSALE WILL TRACK RECRUITMENT METRICS, APPRENTICE HIRING AND COMPLETION RATES, AND PARTICIPANT RETENTION. THE PROGRAM S IMPACT ON EMPLOYMENT AND CERTIFICATION OUTCOMES WILL BE MONITORED AND REPORTED REGULARLY.AERSALE S PROPOSAL OUTLINES A COMPREHENSIVE STRATEGY TO ADDRESS WORKFORCE CHALLENGES IN AVIATION MAINTENANCE, LEVERAGING ITS INDUSTRY EXPERTISE, PARTNERSHIPS, AND COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY AND SUSTAINABILITY.

THE AERONAUTICS PROGRAM AT SAN BERNARDINO VALLEY COLLEGE (SBVC), WHICH IS FULLY ACCREDITED BY THE ACCREDITING COMMISSION FOR COMMUNITY AND JUNIOR COLLEGES (ACCJC), HAS A LONGSTANDING AND WELL-RESPECTED HISTORY IN THE FIELD OF AVIATION.  PER THE AUTHORIZING LEGISLATION, THE PROPOSED PROJECT WOULD ENABLE SBVC TO EXPAND OUR AVIATION MECHANICS AIRFRAME AND POWERPLANT TECHNOLOGY PROGRAM TO HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS  IMPROVE OUR EXISTING PROGRAM WITH UP-TO-DATE TECHNOLOGIES  ESTABLISH SCHOLARSHIPS FOR STUDENTS PURSUING EMPLOYMENT IN THE AVIATION MAINTENANCE INDUSTRY  SUPPORT LOCAL COMMUNITY OUTREACH ABOUT CAREERS IN AVIATION  AND SUPPORT EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES RELATED TO AVIATION MAINTENANCE IN AN ECONOMICALLY DISADVANTAGED REGION.SITUATED AT THE CONVERGENCE OF THREE CITIESSAN BERNARDINO, COLTON, AND RIALTOSBVC SERVES A COMPLEX AND DIVERSE STUDENT POPULATION, MANY OF WHOM HAIL FROM ONE OF THE THIRTY-THREE (33) QUALIFIED ZONES OF OPPORTUNITY LOCATED IN THE COLLEGES IMMEDIATE SERVICE AREA.  THE MAJORITY OF OUR STUDENT BODY ARE REFLECTIVE OF THE SURROUNDING COMMUNITIESPRIMARILY LATINX (67.3%), FIRST-GENERATION COLLEGE STUDENTS (73%), AND LOW-INCOME (65.3%).  THESE DEMOGRAPHICS ARE ALSO REPRESENTATIVE OF MANY OF THE HIGH SCHOOLS AND K-12 DISTRICTS SBVC SERVES AND WITH WHOM THE COLLEGE HAS EXISTING DUAL ENROLLMENT AGREEMENTS.THE PROPOSED PROJECT WOULD ALLOW SAN BERNARDINO VALLEY COLLEGE TO LEVERAGE ITS EXISTING RELATIONSHIPS WITH LOCAL HIGH SCHOOLS AND K-12 DISTRICTS TO EXPAND OUR SUCCESSFUL AVIATION MECHANICS AIRFRAME AND POWERPLANT TECHNOLOGY PROGRAM TO SERVE AN INCREASED NUMBER OF STUDENTS.  AT THE CENTER OF OUR PROPOSED PROJECT IS THE CORE GOAL OF SUCCESSFULLY PREPARING STUDENTS TO SERVE THE ANTICIPATED DEMANDS OF THE U.S. AVIATION INDUSTRY BY PROVIDING THE EDUCATION NECESSARY TO GAIN THE SKILLS AND TRAINING NECESSARY TO SECURE ABOVE-LIVING WAGE CAREER TRAJECTORIES, POTENTIALLY TRANSFORMING THE SOCIOECONOMIC STATUS AND LIFE TRAJECTORIES OF GENERATIONS OF MARGINALIZED PEOPLE IN THE AREA.  PRIMARY GOALS OF THE PROJECT WILL FOCUS ON: 1) RECRUITMENT  2) REGISTRATION AND RETENTION  3) PROGRAM COMPLETION  AND 4) CERTIFICATION.AS A COMMITMENT TO AND IN SUPPORT OF THE PROPOSED PROJECT, SBVC WILL PROVIDE, AT MINIMUM, $106,000 VIA IN-KIND CONTRIBUTIONS, INCLUDING PERSONNEL COSTS AND BENEFITS, MARKETING AND RECRUITING COSTS, AND TRAVEL WHERE APPLICABLE.  IN ORDER TO BRING THE PROJECT TO FULL FRUITION, SVBC IS REQUESTING $498,555 IN FEDERAL FUNDS FOR YEAR 1.  THESE FUNDS WILL BE USED PRIMARILY TO: 1) UPGRADE CURRENT EQUIPMENT TO INCLUDE MORE UP-TO-DATE AND STATE-OF-THE-ART TECHNOLOGIES  2) PURCHASE NECESSARY SUPPLIES FOR THE AFOREMENTIONED EQUIPMENT AND PARTICIPANTS  AND 3) ESTABLISH AND AWARD SCHOLARSHIPS FOR STUDENTS TO DEFRAY THE COSTS OF FAA CERTIFICATION EXAMS AND TO COVER DEFER THE COSTS OF THE TOOL BOXES STUDENTS NEED IN ORDER TO BEGIN WORK.BY CAPITALIZING ON SBVCS ESTABLISHED AVIATION MECHANICS AIRFRAME AND POWERPLANT TECHNOLOGY PROGRAM AND LEVERAGING EXISTING POSITIVE RELATIONSHIPS WITH LOCAL K-12 DISTRICTS, THE PROPOSED PROJECT AIMS TO NOT ONLY INCREASE THE POOL OF FAA-CERTIFIED AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE TECHNICAL WORKERS WITHIN THE REGION, BUT ALSO TO PREPARE STUDENTS FOR POTENTIALLY LIFE-CHANGING OPPORTUNITIES AND CAREERS IN THE FIELD OF AVIATION.  STUDENT SUCCESS THROUGH THE PROPOSED PROJECT MAY VERY WELL LEAD TO ENTIRE FAMILIES WITHIN OUR COMMUNITY AND REGION BEING LIFTED OUT OF THE CYCLE OF POVERTY.
